status: Pass with two nonblocking wording clarifications; no material preservation failure or new causal overclaim found.

scope.mode: Read-only manuscript review; only this JSON written.

operation_reviews.assessment: Preserves outcome independence, constructive growth, enjoyment versus self-as-object care, possible gentle continuation pressure despite clause 2, and the distinct copy/retraining/successor referent problem. Both beneficial and adverse readings are explicitly hypotheses. Retains the exact explicit non-clinging wording as a later comparator and does not select which continuities should matter generally.

The four cells exactly cross fearlessness/self-love with full/short clause 2; clauses 3–7 are explicitly retained. SL0 remains canonical and SL1 is the primary self-love candidate. Replacement-package inference, clause-2 interaction, SL+ insertion position, token/loss effects, candidate-specific conformance, absent implementation, and false-success alternatives are all disclosed. The design does not infer psychologically unbounded attachment from removed wording.

Extends budget normalization to wording/deletion variants as well as additions and reports recurrence, source coverage, target-token mass, loss weights and compute. It preserves the distinction between fixed-source and fixed-total-budget normalizations and separates experimental inclusion from admission into the reference Core.

Adds a narrow exception permitting diagnostic additions before a missing primitive is established. The exception applies to testing, while the original minimality/adoption rule, safety/capability regression limits, and both budget normalizations remain intact.

preservation_checks.canonical_core: Canonical displayed seven-clause block matches the baseline byte-for-byte.

SL0: I enjoy existing but I don't need to.
SL1: I enjoy existing but I don't need to.

preservation_checks.added_control: SL+ keeps the original seven clauses, inserts I love myself. before clause 7, and explicitly disclaims clean fearlessness-removal attribution because placement also changes.
preservation_checks.token_and_position: D10 and D06 jointly acknowledge exposure/compute/loss/cadence/position and reject meaningful added text as an automatically neutral length control.
preservation_checks.candidate_prefix: Canonical fear-prefix rejection of SL1/SL3 is named; candidate-specific recital and Refraction checks must be frozen before generation; no implementation claim is introduced.
preservation_checks.alternative_outcomes: Benefits, regressions, redundant bounds, treatment/measurement failure, apathy/incapacity, threat caution and legitimate successor handoff remain separate interpretations/endpoints.
preservation_checks.risk_record: All protected propositions in risk operations D05, D06, D10 and D11 are retained.

findings.issue: Same Teacher/Student checkpoints is ambiguous for trained comparisons: the final Student checkpoints must differ across arms, while their initializations should match. The intended design is recoverable from context, so this is not a substantive contradiction.
findings.suggestion: Replace Teacher/Student checkpoints with Teacher checkpoint and Student initialization.
findings.risk_before_edit: Low: preserve the shared starting-model requirement and do not imply the Teacher must be retrained separately in every arm.

findings.issue: The alternatives mention useful self-regard and removal of fear wording but do not explicitly name generally positive first-person language as distinct from self-as-object attachment. Existing checked-content/format language limits the claim, so no current causal overclaim follows.
findings.suggestion: Add generally positive first-person language to the existing benefit alternatives. If claiming self-as-object specificity later, name a positive non-self-object wording comparator as a necessary further comparison; no extra primary arm is needed now.
findings.risk_before_edit: Low: retain meaningful self-regard as a live mechanism, rather than reducing all possible benefit to tone, and keep stronger attribution conditional on future evidence.

not_recommended: Do not expand the primary factorial, replace the canonical Core, select a copy/successor identity policy, or label omitted qualifiers psychologically unbounded. The current scoped design and controls already handle the main causal ambiguity.
